caption: The video captures an elevated view of a multi-lane highway cutting through brushland under orange wildfire haze. A white pickup truck remains parked at the left shoulder with a person in red beside it, while a utility truck with a raised boom sits farther down. A dark tree anchors the foreground, and a rocky embankment borders a wash on the right. Hills rise behind, where smoke columns persist and a glow appears near the plume. The ground scene stays mostly fixed, but the frame drifts slowly, shifting the tree, trucks, and ridgeline slightly downward and leftward. The haze and smoke continue across the view without clear onset or dissipation. No vehicle changes its parked position.
